Guidance & outlook: In line with this expanding role, NBFC credit as a proportion of GDP has increased steadily over the past decade from 8.9% in FY2015 to 14.6% in FY2025.
FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE The Company's loan portfolio is at ₹ 345.80 Crore in FY 2026 from ₹ 261.79 Crore in FY 2025 and investments ₹ 271.13 Crore in FY 2026 from ₹ 196.20 Crore in FY 2025.
During the year under consideration, your Company's total income including other income is ₹ 45.73 Crore in FY 2026 as compared to ₹ 33.27 Crore in FY 2025 .
Growth & demand: The Company's loan portfolio increased to ₹345.80 crore from ₹261.79 crore, reflecting continued growth in our lending activities.

Economic activity remained well-supported by domestic drivers, with real GDP growth for FY 2026 is likely to be 7.6% underpinned by healthy consumption trends, sustained government expenditure on infrastructure and steady momentum across industrial and service sectors.
Overall growth remained healthy, with NBFCs AUM (excluding government-owned NBFCs) estimated to grow at 18-19% and cross 50 lakhs crores in FY2027.
